name: Aged Receivables Export downloads binary OpenXML Excel workbook
description:
Objective: Aged Receivables Export downloads binary OpenXML Excel workbook.
Preconditions: Open Reports comprehensive e2e with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Reports comprehensive e2e.
2. Aged Receivables Export downloads binary OpenXML Excel workbook.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Confirm Export action returns HTTP 200 with valid Excel attachment headers and payload.
